judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A decent cumulus-and-contrail sky study with good contrast, but the composition and grain keep it from standing out.
strengths: Strong contrast between bright cumulus and deep blue sky
Textured cloud edges give some depth
Thin contrail adds a focal accent
weaknesses: Cloud mass is cropped awkwardly at the bottom
Large area of empty sky weakens composition
